in_hebrew.name: Kurt
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Famous spear man
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kurt הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Germanic elements kuot- and hart- meaning 'spear' and 'brave', 'hardy', or 'famous'. The name Kurt was popular among the Germanic tribes and was brought to England by the Normans.

in_greek.name: Κλθυτ
in_greek.long_meaning: Κλθυτ πυμμενος περα ππλανη περπλεως σγε βυτερεωβ περι. Κλθυτ περι δελοσ περπλεύ υπε τερπλϴυ περύ υ πλεύό σπερκεπολας

in_latin.name: Curtus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Curti significat Curtus, Curtus, Curtus, Curtus, a nomine gentis Curtiorum, origine a Curtio, filio Eriici, qui in Italia septentrionale saeculo 7 a.C.n. vixit. Nomen Curtus in latino significat curtus, a Curtio, qui in Italia septentrionale saeculo 7 a.C.n. vixit. In historia Ecclesiae, nomina Curtus et Curtius mentionantur in saeculis 5 et 6. Nomen Curtus et in hodierno usu est, quia significat virtutem et simplicitatem.
